body: A piece of streetwear history is making a comeback today. Chief Keef, the Virgil Abloh Foundation and Been Trill are bringing back the iconic “Free Keef” shirt, originally designed in 2013 during the rapper’s incarceration. Featured on the cover of Chief Keef’s ‘Almighty So’ and worn by Rihanna, Travis Scott and A$AP Mob, the shirt returns 13 years later in honor of Virgil Abloh’s creative legacy. Available now on Complex.
